producer_report.summary: The pin stays exact. I added `cargo run -p xtask -- repin [--claude <path>]`. It runs `--version` on the claude from the machine config, else the one on PATH, and rewrites only the version inside the quotes of the `claude_version` line in athena.toml. A second run changes nothing. An empty or non-numeric version, a failed probe or a missing line is an error, and the file is left untouched. The refusal in `check_pinned` now names the found and pinned versions and says to run that command, then ./setup.sh. Tests cover the refusal text, the exact-match accept, and the repin rewrite, idempotence and refusals. I added decision D154, a CHANGELOG entry and a README section. D154 cites no earlier decision, so decision-links.toml needs no entry. The full `cargo test --locked` ran once, but I could not read its summary line, so I don't have a seen pass for it.

checks_run.note: 13 passed, incl. the refusal-message and exact-match tests
Ran once; the tool returned without an error, but the output was too large to inline and I could not read the saved file, so I did not see the final summary line.

criteria_check.criterion: A stand-in claude reporting a version different from the pin is still refused by check_pinned, and the error names both the found and pinned versions and tells the reader to run the new xtask repin command. Run `cargo test -p athena-agent`.
criteria_check.evidence: Test a_host_that_is_not_the_pinned_version_is_refused now asserts the Spawn error contains 2.1.299, 9.9.9 and `cargo run -p xtask -- repin`; passed in `cargo test -p athena-agent claude`.

criteria_check.criterion: The new xtask command, run against a temporary athena.toml and a stand-in claude reporting 2.1.305, rewrites claude_version to "2.1.305" and leaves every other line byte-identical; a second run changes nothing; an empty or unparseable version leaves the file untouched and errors. Run `cargo test -p xtask`.
criteria_check.evidence: xtask tests repin_sets_only_the_version_and_is_idempotent and repin_refuses_an_empty_or_unparseable_version_and_keeps_the_file passed (`cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask repin`). They compare whole file contents with a trailing comment preserved, and cover empty, blank, 'not-a-version', 'v2' and a missing binary.

criteria_check.criterion: The existing exact-match behaviour is unchanged: a binary whose version equals the pin is accepted and the reported version recorded. Run `cargo test -p athena-agent`.
criteria_check.evidence: New test a_host_at_exactly_the_pinned_version_is_accepted passes; the stand-in driver helper still builds via check_pinned with the exact pin, and the other stand-in tests pass.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo test --locked --workspace`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` pass, including the decision-links backtest test.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I also ran clippy (-D warnings), fmt --check and `cargo test -p athena-cli --test backtest` (21 passed, including the decision-links test); D154 holds no link to an earlier decision.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/decisions.md has an entry recording the choice (exact pin kept, one repin command, alternatives: accept newer patches, auto-repin; cost: a manual command after each update). Any link to an earlier decision in it is registered in docs/decision-links.toml, and CHANGELOG.md and README.md describe the command.
criteria_check.evidence: Added D154 with case, decision, both alternatives, tradeoff and reversal cost. It cites no earlier decision, so decision-links.toml needs no entry. CHANGELOG.md Unreleased/Added and a new README section describe the command.

criteria_check.criterion: athena.toml, defaults.toml, setup.sh and .github/workflows are unchanged (Grep/git diff shows no edits), and no secrets or personal data are committed.
criteria_check.evidence: I edited none of those files; only the six files in the summary changed. The policy scan passed.

mistakes: I could not read the full `cargo test --locked` output, so I have no seen summary line for it; I ran the backtest and policy tests on their own as evidence.
learnings: check_pinned's message is the only place the refusal text lives; wiring.rs claude_bin reads claude_bin from $ATHENA_HOME/config.toml, which repin mirrors with a small hand parse because xtask has toml only as a dev-dependency.
Wording a decision entry without 'amends/supersedes Dxx' avoids the decision-links backtest.
desires: Being able to read a saved tool-output file, so a long test run's summary line could be checked.
